turns: Highly rated feel-good comedies
results.reply:
The top results fit the wish well: all are comedies scoring high on feel-good, and most also score high on funny. Groundhog Day has the strongest comedy score, while Intouchables leads on feel-good. The picks below are the first five listed, with their tag scores.

**Little Miss Sunshine** — feel-good 92%, comedy 91%, funny 81%; it follows a stressed mother and her family in Albuquerque.
**Intouchables** — feel-good 97%, comedy 86%, funny 73%; a Paris story about the driver Driss and the quadriplegic Philippe.
**Crazy, Stupid, Love.** — feel-good 92%, comedy 94%, funny 81%; a family man's life unravels after his wife asks for a divorce.
**Groundhog Day** — feel-good 88%, comedy 97%, funny 81%; a cynical TV weatherman relives February 1 in Pittsburgh.
**Hunt for the Wilderpeople** — feel-good 87%, comedy 93%, funny 84%; a runaway foster child is taken in by Bella and Hector in New Zealand.

judge.reason: All five are well-regarded comedies or comedy-dramas with warm, uplifting tones (Little Miss Sunshine, Intouchables, Groundhog Day, and Wilderpeople are especially beloved), and Crazy, Stupid, Love. is a solid, charming crowd-pleaser, so the list fits the wish very well.

turns: Something romantic and funny, a little bit scary, with good ratings
results.reply:
The top picks match the romantic and funny parts of your wish well, with strong romance and humor scores. None of them offers the scary part, so "a little bit scary" isn't met. I can make scary a must if you'd like only films that have it.

**Crazy, Stupid, Love.** — Romantic (97%) and funny (81%); a middle-aged family man's life unravels when his wife asks for a divorce after revealing an affair.
**When Harry Met Sally...** — Romantic (99%) and funny (73%); cynical Harry and optimistic Sally debate their views on a road trip to New York.
**The Princess Bride** — Romantic (89%) and funny (74%); a grandfather reads a novel about farmhand Westley and Buttercup to his sick grandson.

judge.reason: All five are well-rated, funny romances, but none is actually scary, so the 'a little bit scary' part of the wish is mostly missed (The Princess Bride's mild peril and Groundhog Day's dark undertones are the closest).
